QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your beginnings to regain your lost memory. Beginnings? Wouldn't that be when you met the Empress and Neinheart in Remote Forest? Pay a visit to #b#p1101002##k.
QuestInfo.1: You met up with #p1101002# after all this time. He recalled meeting you for the first time at the Remote Forest and reminisced about that encounter.
